summary.title: SadServers - Hands-On Linux & DevOps
summary.one_liner: SadServers is a site of hands-on Linux and DevOps troubleshooting challenges run on live servers, usable without sign-up.
takeaways: SadServers offers troubleshooting challenges that run on live Linux servers.
The challenges target DevOps and SRE skills and are also used as hiring assessments.
No sign-up is required, according to the page.
summary.summary: The SadServers home page presents itself as a set of Linux and DevOps troubleshooting challenges carried out on live servers. It describes the challenges as fun, real-world exercises for engineers and as assessments for hiring teams, and compares them to LeetCode for Linux and DevOps. The page states that no sign-up is required. It contains little detail beyond this positioning, so specifics of individual challenges are not described here.
